method: Restricted-root replay of only the three confirmed development cases, using the exact captured v0.10 binary. Each fresh process scores only the played move at one ply beyond the live completed depth, to check whether the prior two-choice replay result was strictly better or a random tie. This does not establish the best move among all legal choices. No clock limit is supplied; a separate 20-second client watchdog records errors if the requested depth cannot complete. No engine source or evaluation weights changed. This diagnostic tests sensitivity to the main-search horizon; it does not test a quiescence or evaluation modification.
